title: On the exponential sum over squarefree integers
summary: Let $μ$ be the Möbius function and $e(t)=e^{2πit}$. We prove that if $N\ge2$, $α\in\mathbb{R}$, $(a,q)=1$, and $|α-a/q|\le q^{-2}$, then \[\bigg|\sum_{n\le N}μ^2(n)e(αn)\bigg|\ll\left(\frac Nq+q\right)(\log 2N)^5, \] with an absolute implied constant, and we deduce the corresponding estimate on the minor arcs of the Hardy--Littlewood dissection throughout the range $Q\le N^{1/2}$. The estimates of Schlage-Puchta [SP] and of Tolev [T] have the same dependence on $q$ and $Q$ but carry a factor $N^{\varepsilon}$.
